import { IconPackage } from "@tabler/icons-react"
import { Empty, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from "@/components/ui/empty"

export const title = "Empty with Long Description"

const Example = () => (
  <Empty>
    <EmptyHeader>
      <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
        <IconPackage />
      </EmptyMedia>
      <EmptyTitle>No products available</EmptyTitle>
      <EmptyDescription>
        There are no products in this category yet. Check back later or browse other categories to discover what we have
        to offer.
      </EmptyDescription>
    </EmptyHeader>
  </Empty>
)

export default Example
